summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, announcing a private offering of $100 million aggregate principal amount of 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030. The New Notes are additional notes under an October 6, 2025 indenture governing $400 million of existing notes, treated as a single class with identical terms aside from issue date, first interest payment date, accrual date, and issue price. The Issuers are certain subsidiaries, with a full and unconditional Company guarantee. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, repurchase agreement repayment, and asset purchases. Sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
